name: Buncombe County, NC
findings: Buncombe County has 954 nonprofit organizations. 456 of them (48%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 363 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (17% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, Buncombe County has about as many organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: Community organizations stand out for membership
observations.text: 20 community organizations here list membership, compared with about 7 in similar places of this size.
